metadata.name: bonding_curve
metadata.description: Hand-authored IDL (not generated by `anchor build`, which needs the Solana/Anchor toolchain — unavailable in the environment this was written in). Matches anchor-program/programs/bonding_curve/src exactly as of this commit: instruction/account discriminators are the standard Anchor sha256('global:'+name) / sha256('account:'+Name) scheme, verified by direct computation, not guessed. Only the six instructions actually wired up in the frontend (initialize, update_oracle_authority, create_token, buy, sell, claim_fee_split_wallet) are included; reserve_claim/claim_tokens/revoke_claim/claim_creator_fees_wallet(legacy)/claim_creator_fees_social(legacy)/create_bonding_curve(legacy)/init_creator_fee_vault(legacy) still exist and work on-chain, they're just not exposed here yet. create_token's creator-fee side now goes through a FeeSplitter PDA (per-mint, up to 5 independently-claimable recipients) instead of the old single-recipient CreatorFeeVault — see FeeSplitter/FeeSplitRecipient/FeeSplitRecipientInput below. Regenerate this file for real via `anchor build` once the toolchain is available, as a correctness check against this hand-written version.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Admin-only, called once at deploy time. Sets Platform Fee, Creator Fee, fee_recipient, and oracle_authority.

instructions.name: update_oracle_authority
docs: Admin-only. Rotates the oracle's public key.

instructions.name: create_token
docs: Atomic launch: mints 100% of supply onto the curve, revokes mint+freeze authority, activates the bonding curve, and initializes a FeeSplitter (up to 5 creator-side beneficiaries, each with their own bps share) — all in one instruction.

instructions.name: claim_fee_split_wallet
docs: Trustless direct claim of one recipient's share of a FeeSplitter — that recipient's creator_type must be Wallet. No oracle, no backend; the registered wallet signs and withdraws its own accrued share, independently of every other recipient in the same array.

types.name: FeeSplitter
docs: Per-mint PDA holding up to 5 independently-claimable creator-fee recipients. Each trade's creator_fee lamports land here in one transfer, then get divided across recipients[0..recipient_count] by FeeSplitter::distribute per each recipient's bps share (summing to FEE_SPLIT_TOTAL_BPS = 10000 = 100% of the creator's share, not of total trade volume).

types.name: FeeSplitRecipient
docs: One beneficiary's slot inside a FeeSplitter. identity holds either a 32-byte wallet pubkey (creatorType == Wallet) or a UTF-8 social handle padded to 64 bytes (creatorType == X/TikTok/Gmail), with identityLen giving the handle's real byte length.

types.name: FeeSplitRecipientInput
docs: create_token instruction arg — one entry of the `recipients` Vec. Exactly one of socialHandle/wallet must be set, matching creatorType (Wallet -> wallet, X/TikTok/Gmail -> socialHandle). All entries' bps must sum to exactly FEE_SPLIT_TOTAL_BPS (10000).
